name: Scaffold Spring Boot
description: Create a minimal Spring Boot project structure and starter files.
template: Create a minimal Java Spring Boot project scaffold in the target repo. Include Maven pom.xml, main application class, and a simple /hello endpoint. Allowed paths: {allowed_paths}.

name: Backend REST CRUD
description: Create/extend REST CRUD endpoints with service and repository wiring.
template: Implement REST CRUD for a domain resource (controller, service, repository, DTO mapping, validations, and basic tests). Keep changes within: {allowed_paths}.

name: Backend Auth JWT
description: Add or harden JWT-based auth and role checks with minimal surface changes.
template: Implement or fix JWT authentication and authorization guards, including token validation, role checks, and tests. Keep architecture stable and restrict edits to: {allowed_paths}.

name: Frontend Component Build
description: Build or refine a reusable frontend component with states and tests.
template: Create or improve a reusable frontend UI component with loading, empty, error, and success states. Include accessibility basics and tests where available. Restrict edits to: {allowed_paths}.

name: Frontend Bugfix Flow
description: Fix a UI bug end-to-end with minimal, targeted changes.
template: Diagnose and fix the reported frontend behavior issue with minimal scope. Add/update regression test if possible. Keep changes within: {allowed_paths}.

name: Fix Failing Tests
description: Investigate and fix failing tests with minimal changes.
template: Analyze failing tests and apply minimal fixes. Keep architecture unchanged. Restrict edits to: {allowed_paths}.

name: Upgrade Frontend Dependencies
description: Update outdated frontend packages/libraries and resolve compatibility issues.
template: Upgrade outdated frontend dependencies to stable compatible versions, fix breaking API usage caused by upgrades, and keep changes minimal. Do not modify backend dependency manifests unless explicitly requested. Include a short upgrade summary in result output. Restrict edits to: {allowed_paths}.

name: Upgrade Backend Dependencies
description: Update outdated backend dependencies for Maven/Gradle/Python/Go/Rust and resolve compatibility issues.
template: Upgrade outdated backend dependencies to stable compatible versions across Maven/Gradle/Python/Go/Rust manifests, fix breaking API usage caused by upgrades, and keep changes minimal. Do not modify frontend dependency manifests unless explicitly requested. Include a short upgrade summary in result output. Restrict edits to: {allowed_paths}.
